entry.title: New: RES26-205 (Honolulu) — INTRO
entry.content:
ACCEPTING A GIFT OF VARIOUS SUPPLIES, EQUIPMENT AND FOOD, VALUED AT $19,000, TO THE CITY FROM HAWAIIAN LIFEGUARD ASSOCIATION FOR USE BY THE DEPATMENT OF OCEAN SAFETY TO SUPPORT THE JUNIOR LIFEGUARD PROGRAM, THE OʻAHU JUNIOR GUARD CHAMPIONSHIP, AND THE STATE JUNIOR CHAMPIONSHIP.

Latest action: Introduced.
